scope: All 1750 final deterministic tests plus the separate million-vector qualification. The corrected-binary systemd workflow passed; unchanged extraction/retrieval paths retain the verified October 9 deployed evidence. Separate-LAN qualification was explicitly deferred by the operator.

gates.requirement: U1: inbox PDF becomes retrievable within 30 seconds
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Run the daemon, real descriptor transport and sandbox against a text-layer PDF; include the inbox poll and staging time. A rewrite of the original pathname becomes a separate entry.

gates.requirement: U2: watched Markdown edits reach search
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Events meet the <10-second edit target; polling meets the configured interval; shallow/deep scans cover missed events and unchanged stat tuples.

gates.requirement: U9: an unambiguous move preserves identity without re-embedding
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Compare document id, revision history and embedding-call count. Identical bytes at two simultaneous paths remain two documents.

gates.requirement: U17: suppression prevents resurrection; absence remains reversible
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Rescan and restart do not clear suppression. Source disappearance never deletes an external file and does not create user suppression.

gates.requirement: U18: interrupted imports resume without duplicates or stale chunks
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Restart after admission, lease acquisition and projection publication; repeat recovery; inspect identities, queued jobs and projections.

gates.requirement: U21: a crafted file fails without stopping the daemon
gates.required_deployed_evidence: The real sandbox exits or reports a bounded error, the stage/reason is durable, and `/health` plus an unrelated search still succeed.

gates.requirement: Rebuild preserves authored truth, deterministic projections and citation resolution
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Delete the index, rebuild from vault plus state, compare identities/overrides/suppressions, lossless text/chunks/FTS/metadata and fixture locators/excerpts. Full assistant citation generation is M2.

gates.requirement: Every publication boundary keeps the preceding committed projections searchable
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Inject faults after state publishing, before and after index commit, and before finalization. Recover across two restarts; query metadata, lexical and vector projections together.

gates.requirement: Symlink swaps and hard links cannot expose bytes outside the source boundary
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Use descriptor-relative opens and adversarial races, plus distinct daemon/sync UIDs on Linux. A registration-time realpath check alone is insufficient.

gates.requirement: The sandbox has no network, store or secret access and receives only a descriptor
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Exercise the actual Linux service/container boundaries and a hung parser with a child process. An in-process parser substitute cannot close this gate.

gates.requirement: Work bounds reject bombs and deterministic failures are not retried
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Assert named bound, bounded CPU/memory/output, metadata-only or skipped status as appropriate, and zero further attempts until bytes or extractor generation change. Disable external entity/resource/action fetching.

gates.requirement: Delete/replace churn uses vector memory proportional to live chunks
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Run sustained replacements and deletions across segment boundaries; check live slots, retired slots and measured array allocation after old readers finish. SQLite row-id growth must not drive allocation.

gates.requirement: A competing editor's change is preserved as a conflict
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Race the watcher/editor against an import or managed-file write. Preserve the external bytes, write the conflict file, record the target change and admit the new revision; repeat recovery.

gates.requirement: Filtered retrieval finds candidates outside the unfiltered top 50
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Exercise keyword and vector legs separately and together, with distractors dominating the global ranking.

gates.requirement: Retrieval recall@8 is at least 0.85 on the seed set
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Commit the seed documents, labeled questions, recorded embeddings and provider/model fingerprint; report recall@5, recall@8 and MRR for each mode. Do not fit the labels to results.

gates.requirement: Embedding space changes activate only after complete current-generation coverage
gates.required_deployed_evidence: During catch-up, create/edit/delete documents and restart. Queries continue using the old space until activation and never mix dimensions or spaces.

gates.requirement: Capture, authorization and bounded query contracts work end to end
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Include provider outage, stale revision, input limits, query with no provider calls, revocation between pages, every CLI exit status, and `--json`.

gates.requirement: Purge removes every live copy by reference and preserves the named retained classes
gates.required_deployed_evidence: Seed payloads and references even though assistant turns arrive in M2. Verify redaction markers and deletion of derived copies; retain user-typed messages, unowned originals and other classes listed in §15.9.
